evidence_level: Supplied-liquid equation consistency; not empirical calibration or phase equilibrium.
host_source: melts_silicate_v1.json, states[0].liquid.component_moles; only co2 is changed
carbon_input_basis: mol CO2 independent component; adds one C and two O atoms per formula unit

result.oxide_potential_status: full potentials on the present square subspace; no oxide standards or activities

basis.amount_unit: mol of named independent MELTS liquid component
basis.standard: pure liquid endmember at supplied T_K/P_Pa; no separate pressure correction
basis.activity_convention: activity, ln_activity, ln_gamma use backend_R; ln_activity_common_R = (mu - mu0)/(common_R*T_K); ln_gamma_common_R = ln_activity_common_R - ln(x)
basis.mole_fraction_convention: x and ln_gamma use independent component amounts; backend_species.x reports internal species, including carbonate in mode 4.
basis.mixing: Full potentials already include ideal and excess mixing; do not add mixing again.

phase_policy.calibration_domain: Not established by this property evaluator; three MORB fixtures and local perturbations are equation references only.
phase_policy.cross_phase_standards: Not aligned to alloy/gas; oxide basis conversion does not establish pure-oxide standards.

capabilities.carbon: co2 component with internal carbonate speciation
capabilities.nitrogen: unsupported; no nitrogen component in the backend basis
capabilities.sulfur: unsupported; so3 is an unparameterized placeholder

backend.build_provenance: Release binary pinned by hash; thermodynamic C build commit is not independently established.
